title: Free Delivery Threshold, Distance-Based Delivery Charge, and 'Delivery in 10 Mins' Label

requirements.text: Add a delivery charge logic to the backend: if the order total is below ₹51, apply a ₹5 delivery charge for delivery distances of 0.5km or under 1km. Orders of ₹51 or above qualify for free delivery regardless of distance within that range.

quotes: Set the Minimum Order for Free Delivery to ₹51. If the order is below ₹51, add a delivery charge of ₹5 under 0.5km or 1km

acceptanceCriteria: Backend order placement logic applies a ₹5 delivery fee when order total < ₹51 and distance is ≤ 1km.
No delivery charge is applied when order total is ₹51 or above.
The delivery charge amount is returned as part of the order/checkout response so the frontend can display it.

requirements.text: Update the checkout page to display the delivery charge breakdown: show ₹5 delivery fee line item when the cart total is below ₹51 and distance is within 0.5km–1km, and show 'Free Delivery' when the order meets the ₹51 minimum. The final order total shown to the user must include the delivery charge where applicable.

quotes: Set the Minimum Order for Free Delivery to ₹51. If the order is below ₹51, add a delivery charge of ₹5 under 0.5km or 1km

acceptanceCriteria: Checkout page shows a 'Delivery Charge: ₹5' line item when cart total < ₹51 and delivery distance is ≤ 1km.
Checkout page shows 'Free Delivery' when cart total is ₹51 or above.
The grand total displayed on checkout includes the ₹5 delivery charge when applicable.
The existing distance-based delivery fee logic for distances beyond 1km is preserved.

requirements.text: On the shop/home page, display a small green text label 'Delivery in 10 Mins' directly below every product name in the product card component (ProductCard.tsx).

quotes: add a small green text 'Delivery in 10 Mins' under every product name on the shop page

acceptanceCriteria: Each product card on the shop page shows the text 'Delivery in 10 Mins' immediately below the product name.
The text is styled in a small green font (e.g., text-green-600 text-xs or similar).
The label appears for all products regardless of category.

constraints: Do not remove or alter existing distance-based delivery fee logic for distances beyond 1km.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Preserve the existing shop open/close toggle and admin login functionality — delivery charge logic must be independent.
nonGoals: Customer Wallet System is out of scope for this build request.
No changes to the admin product management or billing pages.
No changes to order history or past bill displays.
